data.long_meaning: The name Perin is derived from the Tamil word 'perundu' meaning 'lotus flower'. In Hindu mythology, the lotus flower symbolizes purity, creation, and enlightenment. It is also associated with the goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, learning, and wisdom. The name Perin carries the meaning “Lotus Flower” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Perin usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
